observed.caption: A group of people gather at night under a graffiti-covered overpass around a large bird with outstretched wings perched on a person's head near cardboard boxes and sacks on the ground.
observed.description: An outdoor night scene illuminated by artificial light shows a crowd of people standing closely together on uneven dirt ground beneath a dark concrete overpass with graffiti-covered walls. In the center-right, a large brown bird of prey with wings partially spread is perched on the head of a person wearing an orange and gray jacket and a blue knit hat who is bending over a cardboard box and woven sacks on the ground. Surrounding individuals wear jackets, plaid shirts, and knit hats and are looking down toward the boxes, some holding mobile phones or small items. The background wall displays faded graffiti and text, and the overall lighting is harsh and uneven against the dark night.
